rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a foot-operated pedal on a bicycle, car, piano, or other machine.

example.english: The pedal suddenly came loose while I was riding my bicycle.
example.traditional: 我踩單車嗰陣，個踏板突然鬆咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 caai2 daan1 ce1 go2 zan6 go3 daap6 baan2 dat6 jin4 sung1 zo2
